To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the theory of finance has been a major source of progress for financial strategy and that it will continue to be so in the future.

financial theory has been a powerful tool in financial decision making and has made significant contributions to the practice of finance, but that it has also been a major source of the financial crisis of the last years.
financial theory and strategy are closely linked, that they are both normative and positive in nature and that they are both academic and decision making oriented. (EN)
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1. Theoretical evolutions in finance; 2. The contribution of finance theory to financial strategy; 3. The normative dimension of finance.
financial theory and financial strategy, but we are not only interested by the theory of finance.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
financial theory and strategy are not two separate entities.
finance theory and finance strategy are two sides of the same coin.
financial theory is a very important tool for financial strategists but it is not a substitute for the strategic decision maker.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
financial research should be normative and should contribute to the development of financial strategies.
financial theory is a very useful tool to improve financial strategy, if we keep in mind that it is only a tool, not the end.
financial theory has to be used for the development and the control of the financial strategy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
financial theory is not a theory of financial strategy.
financial research is a very rich and diversified domain.
there is a need of a more integrated view between financial theory and financial strategy, which is the only way to provide a real contribution to the financial management of the firm.
